long_biography.plain_text:
Dimitris Procopiou established Centrofin as a separate Greek shipping group after ending a fleet partnership with his brother George. The brothers had co-founded Sea Traders and developed a mixed commercial fleet before dividing their interests. Centrofin was established in 1992 and concentrated on tanker and dry-bulk shipping.

Procopiou has emphasised practical operating discipline, including shipyard location, repair planning, workshop capability and delivery schedules. Centrofin assigns tanker technical management to Marine Trust and dry-cargo management to Trust Bulkers. The privately owned, family-run group continues across both markets, with Yiannis Procopiou serving as chief executive.
